issues.description: Method name inconsistency for the "total number of students" accessor: the problem statement (line 41 in problem_statement.md) refers to the method using snake_case as get_total_number_of_students(), while the UML in the same problem statement (line 70), the template TODO comment (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 12) and the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 75) use the Java camelCase identifier getTotalNumberOfStudents(). This mismatch can lead students to implement or search for the wrong method name and cause failing tests or confusion when following the starter code and UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across artifacts. Update problem_statement.md (line 41) to refer to the Java camelCase method getTotalNumberOfStudents() (or explicitly state "implement getTotalNumberOfStudents()") so it matches the UML, the template TODO, and the solution. This removes ambiguity for students and prevents implementing or searching for a mismatched identifier.
